scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run migrate up
scripts.db:migrate:down: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run migrate down 1
scripts.db:migrate:status: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "table pgmigrations order by id"'
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run seed
scripts.db:seed:ci: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run seed -- --scale=0.1
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"' && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:bench: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run bench:copy
scripts.db:log:on: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET log_min_duration_statement = 0" -c "SELECT pg_reload_conf()"'
scripts.db:log:off: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "ALTER SYSTEM RESET log_min_duration_statement" -c "SELECT pg_reload_conf()"'
scripts.db:log:status: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "show log_min_duration_statement"'
scripts.db:activity: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "select pid, state, left(query, 140) as query from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and pid <> pg_backend_pid() order by state"'
scripts.db:test: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run test:e2e
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes && docker compose logs -f
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d && docker compose logs -f
